place: Arab Belt strip along the Turkish border, from Dêrik (al-Malikiyah) to Serêkaniyê (Ras al-Ayn)

Syrians for Truth and Justice says the expropriation disproportionately hit Kurdish landowners; some Syrian commentators dispute the scale of the displacement.
